groups.notes: One applicant received a special-class place nearer home and was removed from list. Source does not say whether replacement offer was made.

metric_definitions.waiting_list_removed_other_school_place: Explicit removal because a place was received in another school; does not assert offer-acceptance dates or replacement admission.

groups.notes: One pupil transferred out freeing a place. No explicit reoffer/acceptance/admission to a waiting applicant.

metric_definitions.vacancy_created_by_transfer: Explicit vacancy created by pupil transferring out; not evidence it was reoffered or filled.
